_comment: Upstream source for every mark in apps/docs/public/logos/. Re-fetch these, then run normalize-logos.mjs. Always pick the variant that reads on white (npm's README background).

interlace.note: local; light-pair mark for white backgrounds

eslint.note: local; carries its own prefers-color-scheme dark override

oxlint.note: oxc names its variants by INK colour, not background — '-dark' is the dark-ink file for light backgrounds

express.note: '-white' is invisible on npm's white background

react.note: react.dev light-theme blue; brand cyan 61DAFB is unreadable on white

drizzle.note: brand lime C5F74F is unreadable on white; drizzle's own site uses black on light

lambda.note: not in simple-icons; AWS blocks direct hotlinking from awsstatic
